candidates.claim: The new Key Manager nav item is gated only on the service catalog and skips isEnabled("key-manager"). The comment above isEnabled says deny always wins and a service can be hidden by deniedServices alone, but enabledServices/deniedServices have no effect on Key Manager, so an operator cannot hide it or exclude it from an allowlist.
candidates.evidence: Comment at lines 29-31 at fd248f08: "Deny always wins and applies even without an allow/enabled list, so a service can be hidden by deniedServices alone ... see resolveServiceVisibility." Every other built-in item uses `&& isEnabled(...)` (images, flavors, securitygroups, floatingips, routers, containers, ceph-containers). The new entry uses only `serviceIndex["key-manager"]?.["barbican"]`. The route beforeLoad in key-manager.tsx also checks only the catalog, so a denied service stays reachable by URL.
candidates.precedent: Extensions at lines 176-178 check both enabledServices and deniedServices.
